item.title: LIST: Tampa's Straz Center announces next seasons Broadway lineup
item.description: Straz Center for the Performing Arts announced the lineup for the 2026-2027 Bank of America Broadway season on Friday.

item.title: Alafia River no longer a source for drinking water due to severe drought
item.description: Due to persistent severe drought conditions, Tampa Bay Water announced that water from rivers is no longer viable as a source for the drinking water supply in the surrounding area.

item.title: From rat poison to a bionic knee: Thousands of odd items found in unclaimed luggage last year
item.description: The vast majority of items left behind during the 2025 travel year were various articles of clothing, but things certainly got a lot weirder.

item.title: Roof collapses due to fire at Pinellas Park auto shop
item.description: Firefighters are battling a fire at an auto repair shop in Pinellas Park.

item.title: Scholarship created in honor of Polk County soldier killed in Kuwait
item.description: A scholarship has been created in honor of Captain Cody Khork, who was among six U.S. service members killed during a drone strike in Kuwait.

item.title: Hillsborough woman's insurance information mixed up with another patient
item.description: Better Call Behnken is helping a Hillsborough County woman after a medical billing error led to her personal insurance information being entangled with another patient with the same first and last name.

item.title: CENTCOM commander says Iran is 'deliberately targeting' civilians in conflict
item.description: Admiral Brad Cooper, the commander of CENTCOM at the MacDill Air Force Base in Tampa, said they are working to address the threat across the region.

item.description: A murder suspect shot a man during an argument the victim tried to de-escalate, Lakeland police said.
